purpose: Diagnose reproduced authenticated full purchase-detail 503 without weakening read validation, and expose the existing safe support code in the UI.
constraints: Root is sole publisher; preserve immutable admission marker and exact-head CI.

Emit only bounded read operation/stage/reason, allowlisted exception category, SQL error number and duration through existing server logging. Never log SQL, parameters, rows, document IDs, credentials, connection strings, raw exception text/objects or private paths.
Retain existing read-only SQL, authority, schema and data validation, masking, cleanup, cancellation and 503 behavior. No command activation or business writes.
No new diagnostic HTTP route. Logging failures must not change read results.
Use synthetic regression fixtures including secret-bearing failures; verify diagnostics stay sanitized and private business data never enters the public repository.
